description.message: Connects ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and DeepSeek chats to the Helpix app: run commands, paste screenshots and diagnostics.

outputPasted.message: Output pasted into the chat: check it and press Enter.

busy.message: Helpix is already running a command

notConnected.message: Helpix isn't connected to this browser. In Helpix open Settings › Connect browser.

screenshotTip.message: Screenshot: select part of the screen and I'll paste it here

diagnosticsTip.message: Diagnostics: collects PC information, you review it in Helpix and I paste it here

shotHint.message: Select the area to capture (Esc to cancel)

diagHint.message: Helpix is collecting the information: review it in the Helpix window

shotPasted.message: Screenshot pasted: add a description and send.

textPasted.message: Pasted into the chat: check it and send.

noComposer.message: Can't find the chat box: click into it and try again.

copied.message: Copied: press Ctrl+V in the chat.

packagePasted.message: Task pasted: check it and press Enter.

reload.message: Helpix was updated: reload the page.

statusMissing.message: Helpix isn't connected to this browser

popupMissingHelp.message: Install Helpix and, in the app, open Settings › Connect browser (or run “helpix --connect-browser”). Then press Retry.

popupAppHelp.message: The extension is ready: open Helpix to use it.

popupOnHelp.message: In the chats you'll find “Run with Helpix” below code blocks and the Screenshot and Diagnostics buttons on the side.

showPill.message: Show the side buttons in chats

privacy.message: The extension doesn't read your conversations or send messages: it only acts when you press one of its buttons.
